Optimized recommends a %1$d-token context (%2$d is a conservative device target) and phase output budgets of %3$d control, %4$d Build, and %5$d summary tokens. Edit context and output in the General or role cards; saved values are respected and are not silently capped.
Optimized recommendation when General is unset: %1$d control tokens; Orchestrator and Coder use %2$d during Build. Saved values are used as entered.

Optimized recommendation when this role is unset: %1$d Plan/control tokens and %2$d during Build. Saved values are used as entered.
